span.p: Phase B - Tracing and Root Cause

span.p:
7. CONTINUOUS LEARNING
expert technician video to procedure
grows defect-cause-fix library & impact card
Gemini Video + BigQuery

div.style: color: rgb(230, 81, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. TECHNICIAN COPILOT
live voice + camera, step by step (Vietnamese)
Phase B diagnostic check & Phase C repair
Gemini Live API

div.style: color: rgb(230, 81, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. INCIDENT SCRIBE
drafts work order / 8D report / SOP proposal
drafts only - human approves
Gemini

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. TRACEABILITY
discrete topology & ranked suspects
product to machine / tool / mold / lot / operator
RUNS FIRST - sequential and mandatory
BigQuery + ADK tool

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. PROCESS ANALYST
continuous sensor telemetry & window
vibration / temperature / current vs baseline
BigQuery + Gemini

div.style: color: rgb(13, 71, 161) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. ROOT CAUSE (RCA)
5-Whys + Ishikawa fishbone
synthesizes evidence & queries RAG tool
ranked hypotheses with confidence
Gemini + Vertex AI Search

div.style: color: rgb(27, 94, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. QUALITY INSPECTOR
defect type / location / severity + SPC
classifies defect for the Orchestrator & re-verifies N good products
Gemma edge gateway + Gemini Vision

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ORCHESTRATOR AGENT (ADK)
receives every input, opens the incident
sole writer of the board, decides who runs next
publishes every output

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SHARED INCIDENT STATE - Firestore blackboard
every message = finding | evidence | confidence | citation
